answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because pulse only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, spiral is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any lantern approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
